deviation.reason: user directed in-place work on main at Phase 0

quality_review.note: The correctness reviewer subagent failed twice on a provider error (assistant message prefill unsupported); that review was performed directly instead, by executing probe scripts against the real modules rather than reading them.

findings.detail: repairState kept 3+ sweeps from a tampered save while clamping sweepIndex to 2, leaving sweeps.length above sweepIndex and granting an extra turn.
findings.fix: Slice to SWEEPS_TOTAL and derive sweepIndex from surviving sweeps.

findings.detail: repairState honoured a terminal verdict claimed with zero sweeps, so a tampered save could assert a win with no answers.
findings.fix: Terminal verdict only honoured once both sweeps exist.

findings.detail: setInterval drain leaked: the hub tears down by clearing root.innerHTML and GameInstance has no unmount hook, so the timer kept firing against a detached DOM.
findings.fix: Stop on root detachment and on round switch.

findings.detail: Affix matching implemented twice (content-build.matchesAffix, engine.fitsAffix) with different signatures; a future rule change could apply to only one of build-time admission and run-time validation.
findings.fix: Hoisted to types.ts as single source of truth.

findings.detail: Dead MAX_PLAYERS export; plugin used a triple-nested indexed-access type instead of the named InvalidReason union.

security_review.notes: No network calls at runtime (REQ-055 verified). No innerHTML with data — all content via textContent. All submissions normalised to [a-z] before set lookup. No secrets, no console output, no dev endpoints. GloVe/SCOWL confirmed absent from dist/ (REQ-044).

outstanding_concerns.detail: axe-core is not a devDependency, so the automated WCAG 2.1 AA scan behind REQ-049..052 cannot run. Accessibility is implemented and asserted by unit and e2e tests (accessible name, live region text, badge text, numeric text channel) but not machine-audited.
RISK-002 accepted residual: the Answer List is the sole runtime validator (ADR-002), so a corpus omission mis-rejects a valid word with no runtime escape hatch.

e2e ran on chromium only; the mobile-safari and mobile-chrome projects were not exercised for this feature, so NFR-004 cross-runtime determinism is asserted by unit golden vectors rather than by three live runtimes.
GameInstance exposes no unmount hook, so timer teardown relies on root.isConnected. A kit-level lifecycle hook would be more robust and would benefit any future timed game.

post_gate_corrections.detail: TEST-090 (share/view text omits "we asked 100 people") had a .feature scenario but no executable assertion. Only TEST-089 was tested, so the gate overstated coverage of the honesty constraint.
post_gate_corrections.fix: Added 4 unit tests in tests/lowball-share.test.ts plus 3 e2e assertions. Verified by sabotage: setting PANEL_DISCLOSURE to the forbidden phrase now fails 2 tests, where it previously passed.

post_gate_corrections.detail: REQ-053 requires the disclosure wherever a panel score is presented. The reveal lists every answer score but was appended far below the single disclosure near the counter, so compliance depended on scroll position.
post_gate_corrections.fix: buildReveal now renders its own disclosure; asserted by e2e on .lb-reveal .lb-disclosure.

verification_evidence.forbidden_keys_in_pack: none (rank, gloveRank, tier, scowlTier, vector, embedding all absent)
verification_evidence.formula_absent_from_bundle: no log10, Math.pow, LOG_CEIL, FINDABLE_MAX_TIER, MIN_TRAP_SCORE or computePar in dist/assets; panelScore appears only as a data field read and the repairSweep clamp
verification_evidence.adr_005_boundary: nothing under src/ imports tools/ or wordkit/ (matches are comments only); content-build.ts uses no fs API so it is safe on both sides
verification_evidence.largest_dist_file: ladderless.json 4.7MiB — no file approaches the 163MiB GloVe size
